Sample.evidence_source: For those with diabetes, 118 completed T1, 117 completed T2, and 113 completed T3. For those without diabetes, 122 completed T1, 121 completed T2, and 117 completed T3.

infoYearT1.evidence_source: The text mentions the original study (Helgeson et al., 2007) and that the present study's T1 occurred when participants were in their senior year of high school, but no specific calendar year for this study's T1 is provided.

yearT1.evidence_source: The text mentions the original study (Helgeson et al., 2007) and that the present study's T1 occurred when participants were in their senior year of high school, but no specific calendar year for this study's T1 is provided.

country.evidence_source: Those with diabetes were recruited from the Children's Hospital of Pittsburgh's diabetes clinic

Outcome_variable.evidence_source: Questionnaires assessed friend relationships, romantic relationships, psychological distress, life satisfaction, disturbed eating behavior, and, for youth with diabetes, self-care behavior.

sample_type.evidence_source: Those with diabetes were recruited from the Children's Hospital of Pittsburgh's diabetes clinic, and those without diabetes were recruited from physicians' offices and area malls.

ethnicity.evidence_source: Sex, race, social status, household structure, and birthdate were collected from the original study when participants were an average age of 12 years (Helgeson, Snyder, Escobar, Siminerio, & Becker, 2007).

lag.evidence_source: Youth were emailed a link 1 year later (Time 2 [T2]) and 2 years later (Time 3 [T3]) to complete similar online questionnaires.
